target.name: BlackRock Corporate High Yield Fund V, Inc.

acquirer.name: BlackRock Corporate High Yield Fund VI, Inc.

listed_quote.quote: BlackRock Corporate High Yield Fund V, Inc. (NYSE:HYV) and BlackRock Corporate High Yield Fund VI, Inc. (NYSE:HYT)

announcement.quote: have approved the reorganization of each of BHY, COY, CYE, HIS and HYV into HYT, with HYT continuing as the surviving fund (each, a “Reorganization”).

deals.notes: Shareholders of all funds approved on 2013-10-11 (accession 0001341004-13-001059), with the reorganizations expected effective Nov 18, 2013. The target's N-8F (0001341004-13-001258, filed 2013-12-06) checks Merger and says assets were distributed, but in the excerpt it refers only to 'the Surviving Fund' without naming HYT, so under the N-8F rule it settles nothing. No excerpt states completion. The same filings also propose BHY, COY, CYE and HIS into HYT; those are other funds' deals and are not recorded here.

problems: Outcome left null: approval is stated, completion is not, and the N-8F excerpt does not name the surviving fund.
